title: Specimen Collection Appointments — Weekend Charge on Saturday and Sunday Home Visits
content:
## The charge

A collected Mobile In-Home Collection Visit of **Specimen Collection Appointments** whose appointment date is a Saturday or Sunday carries a weekend charge. The weekend charge on a collected home visit dated on a Saturday or Sunday is worked out by calculation rather than as one flat surcharge. It is posted on the visit as one assessed weekend surcharge, dated the day it is posted; the patient then sees it in the visit's fee history as an assessed weekend surcharge owed until settled. A visit carries at most one weekend surcharge.

## When the charge is worked out

The weekend charge on a Saturday or Sunday home visit is not worked out until the visit's fee record shows its assessed trip fee.

Before the weekend charge is worked out for a visit that drew additional household members, the visit must carry its assessed additional-patient fee.

## Posting tool: `assess_weekend_surcharge_242d901c`

**Capability.** Posts the weekend charge on a collected home collection visit held on a Saturday or Sunday. One call adds one assessed weekend-surcharge line, dated today, to the visit's collection-service fee record and raises the visit's outstanding collection-fee balance by that amount.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `assess_weekend_surcharge_242d901c` and then calls it.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `visit_id` | The reference number of the weekend collection visit to charge, read from the visit lookup for the patient | Identifier |
| `fee_amount` | The weekend charge to post, in USD | Positive, 2 decimal places (cents); posted exactly as given, already rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `visit_event_id` (reference number of the new assessed weekend-surcharge line), `visit_id` (the visit charged), `fee_type` (always `weekend_surcharge`), `fee_amount` (the amount posted, USD, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (today's posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `fee_balance` (the visit's outstanding collection-fee balance in USD after posting). A receipt carrying a `visit_event_id` means the charge is on the visit.
